gaps.sentence: I'm fed up ___ listening to excuses.

gaps.explanation: shout AT somebody = be aggressive; shout TO = call so they hear.

gaps.sentence: He spends far too much ___ computer games.
The region is famous ___ its cheese.
They accused him ___ lying to the committee.
The results differ sharply ___ last year's.
gaps.explanation: differ FROM something (one thing differs from another); differ WITH = disagree.

gaps.sentence: Millions suffer ___ hay fever every summer.
They warned us ___ the icy roads.
gaps.explanation: warn somebody ABOUT/OF a danger; warn somebody AGAINST doing.
